summary:
plan.md is written. Empire Stores is a brick block 90 x 37 (main bar x4..93 z4..28 plus the Water Street wing x4..73 z29..40). The roof deck is at y11, and seven bays (piers at x4,17,30,43,54,67,80,93) each get a stepped, corbelled parapet that tops out at y15. Facades: a big arched ground floor, then two rows of windows every 3 blocks with dark-oak shutters standing open, granite-coloured smooth-stone bands, an open cut at x46..51 with a stair up to the roof garden at x31..44, and a black-and-glass rooftop pavilion at x56..91 that tops out at y14.
Jane's Carousel is a clear glass cube at x103..116 z1..14 (walls y1..6) with white mullions and a thin black-edged flat roof at y7. Inside, a 10-wide red, white and gold carousel with a cone canopy and a ring of shroomlights makes the box glow.
It reads as these two buildings because of the long red arcade of shuttered openings facing the river beside the glowing glass box. Nothing was built or rendered yet; only the block names were checked against the toolkit. Empire Stores: seven red-brick bays with arched shopfronts, dark-oak shutters, stepped corbelled parapets, a cut with grand stair to a roof garden. Jane's Carousel: white-mullioned glass cube with a black-edged roof, striped canopy carousel and warm lights inside.
